colour_palette.details: WordPress default theme color tokens (--wp-admin-theme-color: #007cba). Dark background with standard gray and white; lacks the vivid, gritty dive-bar aesthetic.

logo.details: Logo is not rendered as an accessible modern web SVG and is missing from Open Graph social preview meta tags.

typography.details: Uses dns-prefetch for Google Fonts, but typography falls back to system fonts with flat styling on initial render.

contact.details: Public phone number and iconic 6th street location are known, but no public email or web inquiry contact form exists.

online_presence.details: Standard out-of-the-box WordPress installation without custom Open Graph preview images or structured Restaurant schema.

verdict.commercial_rationale: World-famous half-pound Angus burgers featured on Food Network, operating on 6th Street since 1994. The website feels like a generic blog theme rather than a legendary rock-n-roll burger joint.

sample_website.notes: Dark mode, neon-accented rock-n-roll burger bar digital experience.
